title: Free-fall speed
description: Essential: Correctly computes the speed just before parachute opens using v1 = g t1.

title: Deceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration magnitude after parachute opens using a = (v1 - v2) / t2.

title: Total height
description: Essential: Correctly sums the free-fall and deceleration displacements to find the total height.

title: Free-fall displacement
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacement during free fall using h1 = (1/2) g t1^2.

title: Deceleration displacement
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacement during deceleration using a kinematic equation (e.g., h2 = (v2^2 - v1^2)/(-2a)).

title: Sign convention error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for acceleration or velocity change in deceleration phase (e.g., a = (v2 - v1)/t2 without magnitude).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s, m/s^2) throughout calculations.
